finish.summary: Built a compact 3-cell sewing-supplies organiser: a 3-compartment full-depth bin for small notions (pins, buttons, needles), a 2-compartment bin for medium items, and an open full bin for larger supplies (tape roll, marking pens standing upright). Open faces capped and joints bolted. No dedicated sewing props exist in the catalogue, so bins are staged with small-parts heaps, tape and markers to show the intended use; check_build passes with mesh clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Sewing tidy-up — I'll make a compact compartmented organiser for thread, scissors, pins and notions, then dress it so its use reads at a glance.
